licence.note: CC-BY-4.0 permits reproducing and adapting data/reports/*.yaml with attribution. This project still commits only advisory IDs, created dates, candidate counts and statuses (CP3 deliverable 5), never full report text - a narrower choice than the licence requires, made to keep docs/results/ small and to avoid redistributing advisory summaries the Go security team did not intend as a standalone dataset, not because the licence forbids more.
